name: Tactical Package Utility and Powered Resource Allocation
scope: preserve CP146 numerical authority and exact contextual replay behavior while adding information-limited bounded utility for Tactical Power allocation and powered-resource action choice, including K/E direct-vs-Held Main, projected-terminal PDS, and phase-aware tactical Shield recharge reservations
productionBoundary: all CP146-owned C# remains byte-frozen; CP147 adds only TacticalPackageUtilityService.cs and its xUnit tests as the shared deterministic selector contract. Existing gameplay/component numerical authority, Concept, Godot source, ScenarioRunner mechanics, and Technology Numerical Matrix remain unchanged
researchBoundary: the Python whole-combat kernel adds explicitly selected cp147_tactical_utility while retaining cp146_contextual for exact historical reproduction; CP144-CP146 results remain historical evidence under their recorded doctrines
informationBoundary: utility may use own capability, current geometry/track/defensive state, observed hostile actions/emissions, and observable/projected inbound threats; hidden opponent build data is not a legal decision input
interpretationBoundary: CP147 is a logic intervention only. Outcome changes diagnose tactical decision policy and must not be interpreted as automatic weapon, PDS, Reactor, Sensor, EW, defense, AUX, or resource numerical promotion
nextStage: after native CP147 acceptance, rerun the broad whole-combat response surface under the accepted tactical-utility doctrine before numerical tuning or Stage B
